## What

Slice P3 of card 128: `/wip?card=N` scrolls to and highlights that card, and `/wip?agent=<session>` opens that session's agent panel. Card: web-everything `xadunn9` (WE PR #4414; plateau has no card system).

**Stacked on plateau-app#216 (P2), which is stacked on #215 (P1).** This PR is based on `lane/xwtnr2y-sessions-page`, so its diff is only P3. When #216 merges, GitHub retargets it.

- `?card=<id>`: a job or merge-chain row whose ref is `#<id>` gets `data-card` and, when it is the linked card, an outline (`data-card-hit`), and the page scrolls to it once. If the card sits in another scope, the page moves to that scope first. A card not on the page shows a small notice ("Card X is not on this page.").
- `?agent=<session>`: opens that agent panel once (closing it sticks). The `/sessions` transcript ref is the run id, the same key `/wip` agents use. An unknown session shows a notice and opens nothing.
- Nothing errors on a bad or hostile value (escaped, length-capped).
- The /wip sample gains card `#4412` and agent `sample-build-1`, so the `/sessions` sample links land on something. One existing sample count test moved from 8 to 9 jobs.
- Files: `glance-mount.ts`, `glance-view.ts`, `glance.css`, `glance-sample.ts`, tests, `tests/e2e/wip-deeplink.spec.ts`.

## Proof

- Before: `/wip` ignored both params (P2 PR notes say so).
- `npx vitest run`: 204 files, 3177 tests pass, including 10 new mount tests (`?card=ID` marks and scrolls to one card with no notice; unknown card and unknown session each show a note; `?agent=` opens the panel; closing keeps it closed; scope switch; hostile text escaped).
- `verify-lane`: green for `8f8d2d05`.
- Playwright on a throwaway Vite server on port 4647 (stopped by PID; port 4000 untouched), 5 pass: click the card link and the transcript link on `/sessions?sample=1`, at 390 and 1280 px; unknown card and session show the notice with no page error.
- Screenshots: `/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-nicolasgilbert-workspace-webeverything/bd616854-1f67-4f80-8be5-40fe1456e3bf/scratchpad/shots/wip-{card,agent}-{390,1280}.png`, `wip-notice-1280.png` (local files).
